description: This file implements the basic container object functions for the Slap Sco Standard Object within the SLAP framework, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions.

classes.name: SLAP_SCO_STANDARD_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the standard SLAP SCO object containing function pointers and properties specific to the SLAP standard object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapScoStdCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new SLAP SCO Standard Object, setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the SLAP SCO Standard Object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all necessary subordinate objects required by the SLAP SCO Standard Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables and function pointers for the SLAP SCO Standard Object, including inherited setup.
